repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUmopshYqDCrYekUj4

## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-b)

Head-sha: `53a7404c1fb339a146cc0896581f489005127129` · read 2026-11-20T19:02Z

### 维护者速读

- 界面改法与卡一致：列表上方两行、视图设置在视图名旁、标签行常驻、「更多」固定在最右。功能本身不用改。
- 退回是因为测试和测试清单没跟上：两个浏览器测试还按旧的工具栏写（一个会在加载时直接报错），平台测试清单里「列表框架」那一项还写着三行、「选项」按钮和 44 像素的页面栏，PR 却写了「没有改动清单条款」。补齐这些即可。
- 另外提醒落地顺序：在 #35910（去掉「打开记录」设置）合入之前，以前选过「整页打开」的人在界面上改不回来；两张一起或 #35910 先合就没有这个空档。

### Must-fix

1. **`ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` is only half migrated.** The trigger ids moved, but the sort test still pins the per-level chips this PR replaces with one chip (`condition-sort`): L329-330 `sort-chip-toggle-amount` (no longer drawn); the order read expects `['sort-chip-amount', 'sort-chip-stage', 'filter-chip-stage']` from `[data-testid^="sort-chip-"][data-priority]`; the "real drag" of `sort-chip-stage` onto `sort-chip-amount`; and the closing header click expects `sort-chip-amount`. Re-point them to the one chip (`condition-sort`, `sort-chip-more` for +N) and move the level reorder into the sort panel, or void them in the body with the reason.
2. **`ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts:118` throws at module load.** The regex looks in `LIST_FILE` (`ListView.tsx`) for `className={cn(TOOLBAR_TEXT_TRIGGER, PHONE_TOUCH_TARGET, … data-testid="condition-add-filter"`. At this head `condition-add-filter` exists only in `conditions/ListConditionControls.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` no longer imports `TOOLBAR_TEXT_TRIGGER` (`git grep -c` on `ListView.tsx`: 0), so the `throw` fires and the whole spec fails. Point it at the file and the classes the Filter control now uses.
3. **The checklist item `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` is made false and not changed.** The body says "No clause changed", but at this head: `steps[6]` opens "the view bar's Options (选项) popover"; `steps[10]` reads "a 44px page bar with the object's icon and name … ⋮ … 「+ 新建」 on the right; a 40px view bar … 「筛选」「排序」「选项」 plus the search icon on the right; no condition row height while no condition is set"; `steps[11]` uses "选项 → 字段" and "the page bar's object icon"; `acceptance[10]` (clause) "page bar 44, view bar 40 …". Epic #35547 asks each child PR to list the checklist clauses it changes in the same PR. Re-point these, bump the revision with the clause change named, and list it in the body.

### Should-fix

- S1. `ui/e2e/list-frame-geometry-35548.spec.ts` builds the frame from source classes: the page bar from `PageHeader.tsx` and the condition row as an empty `empty:hidden` div. It will likely stay green while pinning a frame the list page no longer draws (page bar 44, empty condition row 0). Migrate it with must-fix 3 (no page bar on the list page; the condition row resident at `min-h-10`). Also check `list-left-edge-35663.spec.ts`, which names "the page bar's object icon", against CI's `Build & E2E UI`.
- S2. Record-open gap: until #35854 (PR #35910) lands, a reader who stored 「Full page」 keeps it with no control to switch back (the new `views.mdx` sentence says the panel "no longer offers it"). Say so in Acceptance notes. Landing order is the seat's call: with #35910 or after it, the gap is zero.

### The seat's four points

1. **No narrowing.** `recordOpen` stays on `ListViewProps` with the same type, documented as accepted and drawn nowhere. The props removed from `ViewSettingsPopoverProps` (`recordOpen`, `sort`, `showInlineEdit`/`inlineEdit`/`setInlineEdit`, `onRefresh`/`refreshing`) are package-internal: `plugin-list/src/index.tsx` exports no `ViewSettings*` at base or head. So `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (two new optional host props, new i18n keys) is the right declaration. Removing the control is grounded: card #35878 「去掉「更多」这一层和里面的两个开关」, whose switches it says #35854 and #35684 cancel. The interim is S2.
2. **Layout, Row color and Save/export are grounded as existing content.** At base the panel already had Layout, Fields, Group, Row color, Row height, Sort and More, and a footer with Restore defaults, Refresh, export, plus `onSave`. The card's list orders the new first level and drops More and Refresh by name. It does not remove these, and its 「不做的」 keeps other view types' content as it is (Layout is the grid ↔ kanban switch). The body names them under "Kept, not named by the card". Fine as a reading. If Sales wants the panel exactly as listed, that is a follow-up card, not a change to this PR.
3. **For the phone cards is present** and names `ConditionChipRow`, `SortPanel`, `FilterPanel`, `ViewSettingsContent` (split from `ViewSettingsPopover`, which is now only the trigger and popover) and `FieldList`, each value + onChange with no container knowledge; no staging layer built (ruling 7045325067). Note for #35883/#35884: none of these is exported from the `@object-ui/plugin-list` entry, so a phone host outside the package needs an export then (a widening on that PR).
4. **Overlap.** Every hunk sits in this card's region (toolbar, condition row, View settings, page header) or #35678's (`SelectionPageBar` ⋮ icon). Real conflicts on landing:
   - With #35909 (#35876): both rewrite the sort chip in `ConditionChipRow`, the `ConditionChipRow` call in `ListView.tsx` (`renderSortLevels` vs `renderSortPanel`) and `list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts` L320-366. Whichever lands second keeps #35909's panel (SortBuilder with reorder handles) behind this PR's one chip.
   - With #35910 (#35854): `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `views.mdx`, and `ObjectView.recordOpenDisplay-26681.test.tsx` (this PR trims it, #35910 deletes it).

### Checked and fine

- Face (`l1-face.mjs --pr 35918`): open draft on `main`; `Fixes #35878` + `Fixes #35678` is a fold, one line per card, as intended (face flags the second keyword by design); changeset covers `plugin-list`, `plugin-grid`, `i18n`; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` right for `none`. Checks at read: 10 success · 10 expected skip · 0 failed · 19 pending.
- #35678 delivered: ⋮ after New at the far right in both faces, `SelectionPageBar` overflow now `MoreVertical`.
- Changeset and `views.mdx` read sentence by sentence against the diff: they match, apart from the interim in S2.
- No sign of copied Twenty/Attio code: repo components and repo naming throughout.

### Owed

- Every check green on the next head; L2 `TIER_DEFAULT` (Clause-② yes) by the seat on it. I read only the delta at the next announced head.

## 席位核对 — delta ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 43ff79480a · read 2026-11-20T21:16Z · delta 53a7404c..43ff7948 (c8030bbf, 03e1946e, merge of `main` dea68e93 with #35909) · L1 only, never an L2

### 维护者速读
- 上一轮退回的三处都补齐了：两个浏览器测试按新的两行工具栏改好，平台测试清单里三项（列表框架、左边线、全选）也按新界面改写并记了版本。
- 「打开记录」这一项不再删掉，挪到视图设置第一层最下面，等 #35910 统一去掉，所以以前选过「整页打开」的人现在也能改回来，上一轮说的空档没了。
- 和已合入的 #35909（列头菜单、排序面板）合并处理得对：唯一的排序标签打开的是 #35909 的那个面板，可以加一级、拖动手柄调先后。
- CI 全绿。落地顺序：等 #35919、#35910 先合，开发再合一次主干，我只看那次合并。

### Delta read
- **Must-fix 1 (35549 sort test) done.** The test now reads the one `condition-sort` chip (`data-levels`, 「Sorted by Amount」, `sort-chip-more` 「+1」), and the chip-before-filter order is `['condition-sort', 'filter-chip-stage']`. After the merge it follows #35909's version: the chip opens `sort-chip-panel`, 「Add sort」 adds the second level, and a real `dragTo` of a `sort-builder-handle` reorders. A header click opens `column-context-menu` and sorts nothing until 「Sort descending」. The resident row is pinned at 40 px empty, with chips, and after Reset/×.
- **Must-fix 2 (phone spec load-time throw) done.** The guard now reads `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (TOUCH_FILE) for `TOOLBAR_TEXT_TRIGGER, PHONE_TOUCH_TARGET … data-testid="toolbar-display-trigger"`, which the View settings trigger draws. `Build & E2E UI` is green at this head.
- **Must-fix 3 (checklist) done.** `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` revision 13: steps[6], [8], [10], [11] and acceptance[10], [11] describe two rows, no page bar, 视图设置 beside the name, the resident 40 px condition row, and ⋮ last. `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` revision 11 moves the selection face to the view bar's end. Each history entry is ref #35878. The JSON parses, and the body lists all three items.
- **S1 done.** `list-frame-geometry-35548` now builds the frame from `objectViewPageHeader.tsx` / `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`, with no page bar and the condition row `min-h-10`. `list-left-edge-35663` reads `VIEW_BAR_OBJECT_NAME` / `VIEW_BAR_END_INSET`, the new exported constants that put the object icon and ⋮ on the 16 px line.
- **S2 closed another way.**
  - The Open records section is kept, drawn last on the first level (`RecordOpenSection` in `ViewSettingsContent`, from the console's `recordOpen`).
  - A reader who stored 「Full page」 can switch back, so the gap is zero whatever lands first.
  - The changeset now says "Open records moved up to the first level", true against the code.
  - The `ListViewProps.recordOpen` doc says the prop draws the section, and it is still not a view setting (`changedCount`/Reset untouched).
  - Card #35878 asks to drop the More layer and its two switches. Inline edit is dropped. Open records stays until #35910, the interim the seat asked for. Grounded.
- **Merge (43ff7948).** Four files conflicted. The resolution keeps #35909's panel behind this PR's one chip (`renderSortLevels={() => sortPanelBody}` for a sort in force, `renderSortPanel` for none), which is the order I asked for in 7048143160. The migrated test helpers (`conditionPanels.ts`, `fieldListRead-11984`, `harness`, `headerMenuSort-35876`, `withheldFields-34901`) open `sort-chip-panel` where a sort is in force. Test UI is green on them.
- Checks at `43ff7948`: 52 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; `mergeable_state` clean. `l1-face` flags only the second `Fixes` (#35678), a fold by design.

### Nit (non-blocking)
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (main's wording, not touched here) says "The list's **Display** menu offers **Open records**". After this PR the reader sees 「View settings」. #35910 rewrites that paragraph when it retires the section, so leave it to #35910 unless this PR lands last and the sentence survives.

### Owed
- Landing after #35919 and #35910, as the seat set. The dev merges main again then; L1-b reads that merge only. Known overlaps: `list-condition-row-35549` with #35919's count reads, `ObjectView.tsx` / `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` with both.
- Seat: L2 at TIER_DEFAULT (Clause-② yes, widening) on the final green head.

请把正文里的 `Fixes #35678` 摘掉。2026-11-20T23:01Z

维护者 2026-11-21 要求改写了 objectstack-ai/objectstack#35678：选中记录后不再换视图行右端的内容，改成列表底部居中浮出操作条。那张卡现在的范围比这个 PR 做的大，这个 PR 合并不应关闭它。

- 这个 PR 里「更多在最右、同一个图标」仍然是要的，保留。
- 「选中时右端换成已选那一面」会被 #35678 之后替换。要不要在这个 PR 里先不做这一面，由你决定；不要求为此返工。
